content: The map doesn't show tilled soil, so I can't confirm crops. The key blocker is time: we need day 5. I'll wait in long chunks (the wait primitive takes minutes) and re-check, keeping the body busy with a bit of watering in between.

args.approach: Still day 2 and the pass is closed until day 5; nothing can get through, so burn time with long waits (plus a watering pass on the crops) and re-check the rockslide after each chunk rather than retrying the blocked corridor.
